## 2026-11-08 07:13 · claude-macbook · immersive-interface-pack

Owner confirmed the quadalign mod fixed the II GUIs. uku's Armor HUD style HOTBAR (and ROUNDED_CORNERS) draws partial slices of hud/hotbar. II's hotbar.png is 364x44 with markers only at its 4 corners, and the shader expands the quad assuming the full 182x22 hotbar, so slices warp. Style ROUNDED uses only hud/hotbar_offhand_left slices (II retextures that sprite without markers), so it renders cleanly. Advised: Mod Menu > uku's Armor HUD > Style = Rounded.
